description: A business's price list or menu, for any kind of business (salon, barber, nails, beauty, restaurant): sections of items with name, description, price_zar (rand) and, for services, duration_min. prices_confirmed is false (with a price_note) when the prices come from the business website and are not confirmed. For a business already found (has_price_list is true in search_local_businesses); it is not a search and gives no business details (use get_business). Takes the id from a search_local_businesses result. An unknown or malformed id returns an error ("WRDO has no public business with that id"); a known business with no list returns empty sections. Never a phone number or email.

id.description: A WRDO business id (lbiz_…), copied from the "id" of a search_local_businesses result. Ids are not guessable; an unknown id returns an error.

name: get_price_list
title: Get a price list
